verdicts.file: Winnemucca Dry Lake, State Route 447 Between Pyramid Lake and Gerlach, Nevada (11128475283).jpg

verdicts.file: Winnemucca Dry Lake, State Route 447 Between Pyramid Lake and Gerlach, Nevada (11128273795).jpg

verdicts.file: Winnemucca Dry Lake, State Route 447 Between Pyramid Lake and Gerlach, Nevada (11128285875).jpg
verdicts.note: Sagebrush-Ebene mit Streckzaeunen und breitem Bergmassiv im Hintergrund. Nichts von der Petroglyphen-Stelle zu sehen.

verdicts.file: Winnemucca Dry Lake, State Route 447 Between Pyramid Lake and Gerlach, Nevada (11128321896).jpg
